messages:
Alex K: EOW async — capacity snapshot + rollover plan. Quick summary: ~12% fleet headroom overall but eu-west-1 is tight (running ~93%). Yesterday: drained 4 preemptible nodes for infra patch and rolled kernel on us-west-2. Blockers: GCP quota request for asia-southeast1 still pending (PR #492), and a couple of Dedicated customer CSR tickets asking for guaranteed slots. Today: follow up on quota, schedule a short migration window, validate autoscaler changes.

Mira S: Current numbers from the monitoring API: total GPUs=320, used=282, idle=38 → 11.9% headroom. Region breakdown: us-west-2 120/132 (9.1% free), eu-west-1 64/68 (5.9% free), eu-central-1 40/44 (9.1% free), asia-southeast1 20/36 (44% free but blocked by quota). Opened support case with GCP: case-8772 (contact: Ravi).

Sam V: can we cold-migrate some Dedicated reserved nodes from eu-west-1→eu-central-1 to avoid SLA risk? Also what’s ETA on the quota approval — if it’s >24h we should migrate.

Mira S: We can cold-migrate up to 6 reserved nodes without infra churn, but needs a 2h ops window. GCP rep said quota ETA is next business day (so >24h likely).

Jen L: FYI provisioning pipeline flaked yesterday on image signing; rollback applied and pipeline passed on retry. Relevant log snippet: ```/var/log/provisioner/2026-03-16.log: ERROR: signature mismatch on image build-2026-03-15-14 -> rolled back to build-2026-03-10-09```

Pranav R: I'll own the migration. Plan: start at 02:00 UTC tonight, migrate 4 reserved nodes → eu-central-1, patch autoscaler preference to favor eu-central for Dedicated traffic. If quota still not approved by 10:00 UTC, we trigger burst-capacity (preemptible-backed) to buy time. ETA for migration ~2.5h including validations.

CapacityBot: AUTO_ALERT: eu-west-1 headroom <10% for 12h. Suggested actions: manual migration | request burst capacity | contact rep.

Alex K: Sounds good. Action items: Pranav = run migration at 02:00 UTC, Mira = keep pushing GCP rep (case-8772) and post updates here, Jen = watch the provisioning pipeline and confirm no regressions post-migration, Sam = notify Solutions / Customer Success for any Dedicated customers impacted and prep rollback comms. I'll update the runbook after migration and add a short checklist for quota-fallback. :thumbsup: 

Sam V: noted — I’ll draft a 1-par note for CS and ping affected accounts. :eyes:

Mira S: adding runbook note to the infra docs now. Will post link here when done.

Pranav R: starting pre-migration health checks at 01:30 UTC. If anyone sees anything odd in the next hour please @pranav.

Jen L: monitoring enabled, will escalate on first error.

Alex K: thanks all — keep updates short here.
